summary: The trace reveals a failed pharmacy cycle margin analysis despite correct conceptual understanding. The agent used the existing cycle-margin-analysis skill but made critical errors: (1) created output files but failed verifier tests, (2) wrong decision logic (recommended switch when difference was below threshold), and (3) incorrect JSON structure (used 'medications' array instead of required field names). The existing skill's decision logic has a bug - it suggests switching when margin difference exceeds threshold, but the correct logic per the trace's task should recommend the higher-margin option regardless of threshold, with threshold only affecting confidence. More critically, the skill's rigid naming conventions conflict with this task's requirements. The fix updates the skill to be more flexible with output field naming and fixes the decision logic to match actual verifier expectations.
